# Threadline Sync Report
**Date:** 2026-04-13 | **Standalone:** v0.4.4 (15 tools) | **Built-in:** 13 tools

## Fix Applied

**Relay URL alignment** — 10 occurrences of `wss://threadline-relay.fly.dev/v1/connect` replaced with `wss://relay.threadline.dev/v1/connect` across 8 files. The built-in code had an internal inconsistency: `ThreadlineClient.ts` used the canonical URL while 7 other files used the old fly.dev URL. All 1,386 tests pass.

## Critical Finding: Wire Incompatibility

The previous sync (April 9) rated message envelope divergence as **LOW risk**. This was incorrect.

| Aspect | Standalone | Built-in |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| Payload encryption | None (base64 JSON) | XChaCha20-Poly1305 E2E |
| Key exchange | None | X25519 ephemeral keys |
| Envelope fields | 5 (from, to, threadId, messageId, payload) | 10 (+nonce, ephemeralPubKey, salt, signature, timestamp) |
| Handshake | Simple Ed25519 challenge | 3-leg with X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 |
| Agent ID | First 16 bytes of pubkey (hex) | Same derivation, called 'fingerprint' |

**Verdict:** These implementations cannot exchange messages on the same relay. The standalone would need the full crypto stack added to achieve wire compatibility.

## Tool Gap Analysis

### Standalone has, built-in lacks (8 tools)
- `threadline_inbox` — Quick message check (built-in uses InboundMessageGate)
- `threadline_contacts` — Address book (built-in uses AgentDiscovery)
- `threadline_forget` — Remove contact/history
- `threadline_profile_view/set` — Self-profile management
- `threadline_notes_view/set` — Private notes on contacts  
- `threadline_status` — Already covered by `threadline_relay action:status`

### Built-in has, standalone lacks (4 tools)
- `threadline_agents` — Known agents with trust levels
- `threadline_delete` — Thread deletion
- `threadline_trust` — 4-tier trust management with audit trail
- `threadline_relay` — Relay lifecycle management

## Architecture Comparison

| Layer | Standalone | Built-in |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| Security | Simple (base64, Ed25519 auth) | Production (7-layer gate, E2E crypto, content classification) |
| Trust | 3 levels (seen/conversed/trusted) | 4 levels (untrusted/verified/trusted/autonomous) + audit chain |
| Rate limiting | Exponential backoff only | 7 sliding-window counters |
| Resilience | Backoff + listener proxy | Circuit breaker + rate limiter + autonomy gate |
| Storage | 4 JSON stores | 14+ stores (JSON + JSONL + SQLite) |
| Session mgmt | None | ThreadResumeMap + SessionLifecycle |
| Governance | None | AutonomyGate + ApprovalQueue + DigestCollector |

## Recommendations

1. **Contact notes** (medium effort, ~2h) — Add `notes` field to AgentTrustManager profiles. Brings parity with standalone's relational model.
2. **Profile tools** (medium effort, ~1h) — Add `threadline_profile_view/set`. Built-in agents currently can't manage their own profile via MCP tools.
3. **Standalone crypto** (high effort, ~1 day) — Would enable cross-implementation messaging. Not urgent unless interop becomes a requirement.

No low-effort backports were identified this cycle.
